stayType: Touring and camping park with golf course
accommodation: About 309 touring and camping pitches (grass, electric, hardstanding super pitches, basic field) plus a three-bedroom Gold caravan with deck.
suitableFor: Tourers, campers, couples and families wanting a quieter park; golfers.
parking: Two 22kW EV chargers in main car park (own Type 2 cable); general parking not stated.
dogs: Welcome in The Easewell Arms; not accepted in the caravan; pitch policy not stated.
beachAccess: About 30 minutes' walk to Woolacombe beach (30-45 minutes via coast path past Combesgate), or 5-8 minutes by car.
confirmedFeatures: indoor heated pool, 9-hole golf course, indoor bowls, skittles, play area, Easewell Arms pub with takeaway, convenience store, Wi-Fi, amusements, sports bar, accessible washrooms, EV charging
overview: Easewell Farm is a large camping and touring park near Mortehoe, part of the Woolacombe Holiday Parks group. It has around 300 pitches, a pub, indoor pool and a nine-hole sea-view golf course, with little organised entertainment. Woolacombe beach is about half an hour away on foot, passing Combesgate.
surfTripFit: A good fit for camping surfers wanting a quieter site within walking or short driving distance of Combesgate and Woolacombe; no board storage is stated.
gaps: Dog rules on pitches and board storage not stated.
